name: Day Hunter grants both halves of its authored haste (#4407)
contract: Evil Never Sleeps 804185 periodically applies Night Hunter 807198 or Day Hunter 807231. In the client's Spell.dbc, Day Hunter 807231 carries the same 3% twice: effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS (216) and effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE (192), which is how the unified authored Haste stat maps onto a 3.3.5 core, and its own buff text reads 'Haste increased by ${$w1}%.'. Night Hunter 807198 instead carries 4% Agility on effect 0 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, misc 1) and a leftover 5% melee/ranged haste on effect 1 that the talent text does not promise, so AscensionWitchHunterCompletion keeps suppressing that one. Extensions.dll resolves $wN from the effect amount at slot N-1 sent by SMSG_ASCENSION_AURA_AMOUNT (AscensionAuraAmounts.cpp), so a missing effect 0 both drops the spell-haste half and prints 0%. The scenario applies each buff as fixture state instead of waiting for the talent's 30-second Moscow-time day/night tick.

steps.label: Main-hand swing timer before Day Hunter
Effect 0 is the 3% spell haste the buff text reads as $w1
Effect 1 is the matching 3% melee/ranged haste
Cast speed returns to its baseline
Night Hunter still grants its authored 4% Agility on effect 0
Night Hunter grants no haste: its unpromised effect 1 stays suppressed
